question: According to Figure 4D-2, what are the general minimum and maximum longitudinal distances from the stop line for the primary signal faces, absent the near-side supplemental-face exception?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 4D-2 shows that primary signal faces must be located a minimum of 40 feet beyond the stop line and, absent a near-side supplemental signal face, a maximum of 180 feet beyond the stop line for 12-inch signal indications. The figure also shows a lower maximum of 120 feet from the stop line for 8-inch signal faces. Standards (mandatory): - "A signal face installed to satisfy the requirements for primary left-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.02 through 4F.08) and primary right-turn signal faces (see Sections 4F.09 through 4F.15), and at least one and preferably both of the minimum of two primary signal faces required for the through movement (or the major turning movement if there is no through movement) on the approach shall be located: 1. No less than 40 feet beyond the stop line, and 2. No more than 180 feet beyond the stop line unless a supplemental near-side signal face is provided." - "The primary signal faces that are used to satisfy the requirements of Item A shall simultaneously satisfy the lateral placement requirement described in Section 4D.07 (see Figure 4D-2)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 4D-2 depicts the hatched placement areas with dimension callouts of "40 ft*" (minimum distance of signal faces from stop line), "120 ft**" (maximum distance from stop line for 8-inch signal face), and "180 ft***" (maximum distance from stop line for 12-inch signal faces, unless a near-side supplemental signal face is used), along with the 20-degree lateral cone originating 10 feet behind the stop line. [Image 4] Page 712 shows the same Figure 4D-2 in the full page context on Page 672 of the MUTCD. [Image 3] Page 714 contains Section 4D.08, which codifies the 40-foot minimum and 180-foot maximum longitudinal distances as a Standard. [Image 2] Page 713 contains Section 4D.07, whose lateral placement requirement must be satisfied simultaneously with the longitudinal limits shown in the figure. Citations: - Section 4D.08 Standard §1 (p.673) - Section 4D.07 Standard §1 (p.671) - Section 4D.07 Option §7 (p.672) - Figure 4D-2 (p.672) - Page 714 - Page 713 - Page 712
gold_answer: At least 40 feet and no more than 180 feet beyond the stop line.
